description: This file defines the 'Contacts' class for the vtiger CRM system, representing contact entities within the CRM. It includes methods for retrieving related records such as opportunities, activities, tickets, quotes, invoices, sales orders, products, purchase orders, emails, and campaigns. It also contains functions for exporting data, handling attachments, and managing contact-specific operations. The class extends CRMEntity, indicating it inherits core CRM functionalities.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: Represents contact records in the vtiger CRM system. Provides methods for retrieving related records, exporting data, and managing contact-specific operations.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count of contacts assigned to a specified user.

methods.name: get_contacts1
methods.description: Retrieves contact details for a user with a specific email address. (Note: Usage status unclear, may be deprecated.)

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Fetches contact details for a user, supporting pagination via from_index and offset. (Note: Usage status unclear, may be deprecated.)

methods.name: process_list_query1
methods.description: Processes a list query and returns contact data in array format.

methods.name: plugin_process_list_query
methods.description: Processes a list query with security parameters and limited fields based on permissions.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Retrieves opportunities related to a contact.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches activities (tasks, events) related to a contact.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves historical activities (completed or deferred) for a contact.

methods.name: get_tickets
methods.description: Gets support tickets associated with a contact.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes related to a contact.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Fetches sales orders linked to a contact.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a contact.

methods.name: get_purchase_orders
methods.description: Gets purchase orders related to a contact.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Fetches emails related to a contact.

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Retrieves campaigns associated with a contact.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Gets invoices linked to a contact.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs a CSV export query for contacts based on given conditions.

methods.name: getColumnNames
methods.description: Returns column names for exporting or data display in Word plugin.

methods.name: get_searchbyemailid
methods.description: Retrieves contacts matching a specific email address or pattern.

methods.name: get_contactsforol
methods.description: Constructs a query to fetch contacts for Outlook plugin based on a username.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles operations when saving a contact, such as storing attachments.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Uploads and associates files as attachments to a contact record.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Moves related records from a list of contacts to another contact, updating various related tables.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates a secondary report query with various joins related to contacts.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table information for related modules such as Calendar, HelpDesk, Quotes, etc.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Removes dependencies of a contact with related entities like Potentials, Activities, Tickets, Quotes, Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, and more. Also backs up deletions into related lists RB table.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks the relationship between a contact and another entity such as Accounts, Potentials, Campaigns, Products, Vendors, or other modules.

methods.name: getPortalEmailContents
methods.description: Generates the content of an email for portal users, including login details and support links, replacing placeholders in a template.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Associates related records with a contact, e.g., Products, Campaigns, Potentials, or default parent behavior.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Returns available list action buttons based on user permissions, such as delete, mass edit, change owner, send mail.
